book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: TIMOTI AE ISA PORO KAENTIYE (TARA YAGANE)

content: Pigoya, ma kamanapa aogima abo: Agogo yagaba uwaena kuntaenaba aborakiye.

Piya, pabi ntagaba wasanamiba ige'wai nki asagayuyigina, mone kutaka ibugakini, paebuta nasima, igebigo'ena pumagini, kamanapa akayasumagini, ino ibagi kamanapa akayuma, kampa i'mupa puma, aota mikenaenaba akayumagini,
iyo'ena kampa puma, imo'enawaipa kampa kasimagini, akaya kamanapa uta nasima, i'ama ntapiyenarapa kampa kabima mimagini, wasanaba ata puwaitama, aogiyenamapa kama potamagini,
iyokina'mipa minaga'ena puwaitamagini, kampa napinta karu'ena kamparagaena pigina, igebigo'enawaimpaba anosakini, Kotikaba kampa napiyigina ari itasaenaga ibegini,
mono iga puma mima agowama nkesegiyenaba ikabitakibewe. Piyama miyiginapa igama kakabitao.

Piya, ka'isa piya kina'miba igebi nkiyobi kamana uma aibo waya'mi ntamapinti ubai'magini, napiyenawaipa iga'na puwaitawe. Piya wae'miba aguntaenawaika kuntaena napiyegana intawamapisa tonaronama ibai puta nasegini,
igeba tonarona kina'mi kamana abima, taga kamana'ama nkagowapa kampa abikena pewe.
We, paipa Yanisige Yampirisige Mosesepa kama potantamesa puma, kana kina'miba taga kamanapa kama potawe. Piya, igewai ntapiyenaba abararanta'ena pegina imatiti'enawaipa ago'enaba piye.
Piya pepa, pintanawaipa agorapa kampa kakawakiye. Kampaye. Piya, pai Yanisige Yampirisige aibo'enawaisipa agantasa puma, kana kina'mi nkaibo'enawaipa a'ya'ma kina'mi nkiyobi aborakini agakibewe.
Pigoya, kaeba agonepa aogima agantane. Piya, tisaena yuganepe, nasikenaenanepe, mikenaenanempa kipe, namatiti'enanepe, paebuma mikenaenanepe, agu kao'enanepe, asima esegima mikenaenanepe,

kama punatantananepe, nauki nakiyenanepe, ago agantane. Piya, Antiyoki kumatape, Aikoniyamu kumatape, Arisitera kumatape, tabe kuntuyena namugu aesaga pintopa nagantane. We, Wa'egawamaba a'ya'ma pi kuntuyenabisa nau'intiye.
Eya, a'ya'ma kina, Karaisiti Isuti atokaema Koti kanta puma misanaga ibemi kina'mipa, igepa wasanamiba karana puwaitakebewe.
Piya, agunta kina'mibe amiyo kina'mibe igeba tonarona ataena pigina anosakiye. Eya, igeba imiyo'ena pigini, to igepa imiyo'ena puwaitakibewe.
Pigoya, kaeba aogi kamana abima esegima kamatiti puntampene. Pi kamanapa upebe po. Piya, ugamintompe kina'mite nkagorepa agantane.
Piya kaeba uwaena yagaranto mintana aota mono isapa maema aisuma abita kanama miyempene. Pi nkisa'ama aogi napiyenaba ugamekana, Karaisiti Isuti kamatiti pegana Kotiba kau'iyeno.
Piya, Piya, a'ya'ma mono isapa Koti ntapiyenabisa aborantiye. Aibumagina, pi kamanapa ketepa aogima purayakima, aguntaenarekaba taupi pima, nasikenaenarepa parutu puratama, arupu kipa purayakiye.
Piya pegina, Koti nkaoyagaramaba monota anosama a'ya'ma aogi yugara yokege peno.
